CustomField.label: Show When JSON
CustomField.description: Answer-driven branching. A predicate in the SAME shape GTM_Assessment_Gate__mdt.Predicate_JSON__c uses -- {"all":[...]} / {"any":[...]} / {"field":k,"op":o,"value":v} -- deliberately reusing that language rather than inventing a second one. BLANK is the important case: a row with no predicate is the slot's DEFAULT and always applies, which is what guarantees the slot is filled on every path. A row WITH a predicate is a VARIANT: it substitutes for the default when the predicate matches, and can never leave the slot empty. Eight slots are answered either way. A predicate may only reference "source", "target", or the base key of a slot at a STRICTLY LOWER position -- scripts/build-instrument.py rule 8 enforces it -- so branches resolve deterministically in position order and the client and the server always agree.
